508:t_2:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Resentment toward $$フル・フロンタル$$'s methods was smoldering among them. I merely steered it.」

508:t_2:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We will get our arrangements for receiving them in order as soon as possible.」

508:t_2:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll contact Captain $$ジンネマン$$ of the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

508:t_2:14.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Also, among them is a double of $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$.」

508:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The girl I saw on the $$グワダン$$ during the $$多元戦争$$...」

508:t_2:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So both $$ミネバ・ザビ$$s have now gathered under our wing.」

508:t_2:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Depending on how it's used, this could shake $$フロンタル$$'s declaration of succession over Earth's humanity.」

508:t_2:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. I'll think it over, taking her human rights into consideration as well.」

508:t_2:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Ordinarily I would like you to lead your own forces, but I assume that would not please you.」

508:t_2:22.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I too am one who has cast off $$ジオン$$... From here on, I will accompany this unit as a lone warrior.」

508:t_2:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I am at least confident that I am more useful than $$シャア$$.」

508:t_2:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. Protect the unit until he comes back.」

508:t_2:25.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're serious?... This is going to get awkward.」

508:t_2:26.en:
$$シン$$
「Maybe we should flatter her a bit and get her to fall back to the rear.」

508:t_2:27.en:
$$キラ$$
「You're too scared, both of you.」

508:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why don't you tell her what $c is all about, like a proper senior?」

508:t_2:29.en:
$n
「No, first I'm challenging her to a match in the simulator. I've got a great training partner now.」

508:t_2:31.en:
$$シン$$
「That's not it, $$セツコ$$! $n is just weird!」

508:t_2:32.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Oh? It seems training for combat against me is a rather peculiar thing to do.」

508:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「B-Banagher! You show $$ハマーン$$ around the unit!」

508:t_2:36.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Lady $$ミネバ$$ was in your care. I must repay you for that as well.」

508:t_2:37.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Oh, no... You really don't need to trouble yourself...!」

508:t_2:38.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「How sloppy of you, $$バナージ$$. Even you, who fear nothing, seem to be afraid of Your Excellency $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_2:39.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「How sad. It seems I am not accepted.」

508:t_2:41.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$n! You're good with older women, right! I'll leave this to you!」

508:t_2:43.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I hear you want a match in the simulator. If you wish it, I will be your opponent.」

508:t_2:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Go easy on them, $$ハマーン$$. Our young ones tend to get shy once they're out of their machines.」

508:t_2:46.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So it seems. They give a different impression from when we meet on the battlefield.」

508:t_2:47.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「With respect, Your Excellency, the same is true of you.」

508:t_2:48.en:
$$クェス$$
「You left $$ジオン$$, so show us a side of you other than the Iron Lady, $$ハマーン$$!」

508:t_2:49.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Very well. I will make an effort.」

508:t_2:50.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(I'm waiting, $$シャア$$. For the day you return to $c.)

508:t_2:51.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(When you come back, I will settle the ties between us...)

508:t_10:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「That was amazing, $$アムロ$$. $$ハマーン$$ really took the bait of your provocation!」

508:t_10:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I didn't mean it that way...」

508:t_10:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I understood a little of how $$ハマーン$$ feels, chasing after him... I suppose that's what turned into words.」

508:t_10:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I totally get that! So that's why $$ハマーン$$ reacted to my words too!」

508:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right, $$クェス$$. From your fierce trash talk, $$ハマーン$$ produced a $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z.」

508:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

508:t_10:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As expected of $$ハマーン$$. She looks calm, yet hides strong emotions deep in her heart.」

508:t_10:10.en:
$$クェス$$
「Hey, AG... If you talk to $$ハマーン$$ in your usual way, won't Z-Chips just keep coming?」

508:t_10:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「I bet $$ハマーン$$ will call you lots of names! Philistine, scum, insolent fool, lowlife!」

508:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-all right...! Since we're here, let's give it a try!」
